advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Decide whether `_latest_result_passed` should also exclude a degraded (`coverage.resolution_class`) or fingerprint-stale PASS so the sign-review suggestion never points at a command resign would refuse.
evidence: attest_gate.py:106-107: `payload = sidecar.latest_review_result(...)` then `return isinstance(payload, dict) and str(payload.get("verdict") or "").upper() == "PASS"`
resign.py:174: `if recorded_verdict != "PASS" or coverage.get("resolution_class"):` refuses, and the docstring (resign.py:146-149) also refuses a stale (fingerprint-changed) PASS
So a PASS sidecar that is degraded or stale makes `_latest_result_passed` True while sign-review would still refuse.
advisory.finding: _latest_result_passed gates the sign-review suggestion only on verdict==PASS, but resign/sign-review additionally refuses a PASS whose coverage.resolution_class is set (degraded) or whose material fingerprint no longer matches. So for a `mismatch` (or unsigned) verdict with a degraded/stale PASS sidecar, the reason still names `rebar sign-review`, which will then refuse — the exact class of dead-end advice bug 529c set out to remove, just narrower.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a claim-gate test for a `mismatch` verdict with no PASS REVIEW_RESULT asserting the reason names `review-plan` and not `sign-review`.
evidence: attest_gate.py:114 `if not _latest_result_passed(ticket_id, repo_root): return f"{prefix} Run \`rebar review-plan {ticket_id}\` to earn one"` — this early return precedes the `if verdict == "mismatch"` branch at line 116

tests/unit/plan_review/test_94a3_material_diff.py:410 `monkeypatch.setattr(attest_gate, "_latest_result_passed", lambda *_a, **_k: True)` inside `test_mismatch_claim_gate_message_names_sign_review_only` — the only mismatch test, forcing the True path

Named violating input: `verify_signature -> {"verified": False, "verdict": "mismatch"}` with NO PASS REVIEW_RESULT on disk (so `_latest_result_passed` returns False) — a case where the new code returns the `review-plan` message instead of the `mismatch`/`sign-review` message, untested by any test in the diff
advisory.finding: The newly-added early return in `_uncertified_plan_review_reason` (attest_gate.py:114-115) suppresses the `sign-review` suggestion whenever `_latest_result_passed` is False — including for a `mismatch` verdict — but no test exercises the `mismatch` + no-PASS-result combination. Both mismatch tests stub `_latest_result_passed` to True, so the interaction between the added early-return and the pre-existing `mismatch` branch is a regression blind spot.
scenarios: A clone where a plan-review signature persisted but verification fails (mismatch) and no PASS REVIEW_RESULT file exists
A refactor reordering the mismatch check ahead of the `_latest_result_passed` gate would pass all existing tests
